title.zh: 急售熔喷布挤出机85流量95级熔喷生产线管材

summary.zh: 该产品为挤出设备，主要材质为PE，适用于做pp.pe管，熔喷布，无纺布，各种材料管等应用场景，支持规格定制与批量供货。
summary.en: This extrusion equipment is primarily made from PE and is suitable for Pp.pe None applications. Custom dimensions and bulk supply are supported.

zh: 挤出设备面向工业与消费品配套场景，可用于防护、包覆、导向和连接等需求。
主要材质为PE，可按项目要求匹配尺寸、壁厚、长度和结构形式，适配不同应用工况。
包装与交付可按需求配置（如重量(g) 1000000），支持稳定供货与长期项目协同。
en: This extrusion equipment is designed for industrial and consumer assembly programs requiring protection, covering, guidance, and connection functions.
The primary material is PE, and dimensions such as outer diameter, wall thickness, length, and profile form can be aligned to project requirements.
Packaging and delivery can be configured as needed (for example: Weight (g) 1000000), supporting stable supply and long-term project coordination.

value.zh: 做pp.pe管，熔喷布，无纺布，各种材料管

key.zh: 是否跨境出口专供货源
